title: Blue Owl co-funds $3.4B Crusoe data center JV in Abilene

sources.quote: announced today a $3.4 billion joint-venture to fund purpose-built data center capacity at the previously announced Lancium Clean Campus in Abilene, Texas.

explain: Blue Owl's real estate funds and Primary Digital Infrastructure agreed to fund a $3.4 billion joint venture for Crusoe's first 200+ megawatt AI data center buildings in Abilene, Texas. The amount is the whole venture; it was later expanded to $15 billion.
